reuse.why: Reuses the small existing pieces (assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, bankSync.syncAccount) but does not extract or share the provider-agnostic link and download flows, copying them from Akahu instead.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, differing only in the provider name, server URL and bank-id expression.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and balance handling in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and types under types/models, matching where the other providers live.

scope.why: Server-side focused; the two desktop-client edits are needed to satisfy the widened provider union, though the request scoped out the client.

maintainability.why: A fifth copy of the link flow and another copy of the download flow means any fix to linking or downloading has to be repeated per provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared link/download helper to go around; the existing shared pieces (assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere, findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse) are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are overt, with only names changed.
